sv.title: Rasar till rekordlägsta efter emissionsbesked
sv.summary: Green Landscaping rasar till rekordlägsta efter beskedet att markskötselbolaget vill ta in nästan en halv miljard kronor i en nyemission.

en.title: Plunges to record low after share issue announcement
en.summary: Green Landscaping plunges to a record low after the groundskeeping company announced it wants to raise almost half a billion kronor in a new share issue.
